name: Jinnai Hitomi
source:
A nurse who began working at “Date Clinic” on Reimi’s recommendation. She and Shiori had been senior and junior colleagues at their previous hospital.

She came to “Date Clinic”—which is located in the suburbs, which offers a pleasant environment, and pays an impeccable salary—to care for her frail brother-in-law.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130303161514/http://www.blackpackage.co.jp/products/r3/char.html]archived official site[/url]]
